About the Position

This FAPESP-supported fellowship involves artificial intelligence research linked to public management through CIA-GP.

Host and Funder

The selected organisation is the research host. FAPESP provides the fellowship funding; applicants should follow the project-specific eligibility and submission instructions in the official call.

About the Fellowship

This FAPESP-supported fellowship involves artificial intelligence research linked to public management through CIA-GP. It is a postdoctoral project appointment and requires a recently completed PhD, with applications submitted under the advert's email instructions.

Research Areas

  • Artificial intelligence
  • Public management
  • Postdoctoral research

Funding and Duration

ComponentDetails
Award or positionPostdoctoral fellowship
Stipend / salaryFAPESP postdoctoral fellowship with a published allowance of BRL 12,570; confirm payment terms and eligibility in the official call.

Eligibility and Requirements

CriterionRequirement
Applicant eligibilityProgramme and project criteria apply; see official eligibility guidance
Academic preparationPhD completed within the previous seven years.
Further conditionsPhD completed within seven years; follow advert's email submission instructions.

Application dates

ComponentDetails
Recruitment statusOpen
Deadline / consideration round15 November 2026
LocationBrazil

About São Paulo Research Foundation (FAPESP)

FAPESP funds research in São Paulo, Brazil, and publishes fellowship opportunities attached to research projects. Applicants follow the host project's submission instructions and the foundation's fellowship eligibility rules.

Official details: Read the programme or project information

Application route: Follow the official application instructions

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Official Link

Full announcement and application portal: https://fapesp.br/oportunidades/centro-de-ia-e-gestao-publica-%28cia-gp%29/9910/

Source: fapesp.br - the details in this listing were recorded from this official page.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 15 November 2026 - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.

How to Apply

Submit your application through the official portal before the deadline: 15 November 2026. Read the eligibility requirements carefully and prepare all requested documents — early applications are strongly recommended for competitive awards.
